title: MemorySpacesFreezeRequest
description: Freeze a space for maintenance or migration. Already-frozen with a matching revision is a no-op success (§7.0.4). Grant: admin. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
idempotency_key.title: IdempotencyKey
